title: hieracium alpinum subsp. halleri
intro: Hieracium alpinum subsp. halleri, commonly known as Alpine Hawk's Beard, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health, due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which may help to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Hieracium alpinum subsp. halleri on human health, but its traditional use suggests a range of potential health benefits.
